view.stem: 把 $1$ 到 $20$ 的整数分成三类：第一类是 $3$ 的倍数，第二类是除以 $3$ 余 $1$ 的数，第三类是除以 $3$ 余 $2$ 的数。哪一组分类完整且正确？

intent.task: Partition all twenty specified integers by their remainder modulo three.
intent.source_solution: The remainder-zero, remainder-one and remainder-two sets are respectively {3,6,9,12,15,18}, {1,4,7,10,13,16,19}, {2,5,8,11,14,17,20}. Their disjoint union is exactly 1..20.
intent.unit_reason: One complete three-class result retains the rule and exhaustive partition rather than twenty cell clicks.
limitations: Recognizing supplied complete lists does not test independently generating every list.

rationales.derivation: The correct remainder-zero list is kept, but the remainder-one and remainder-two lists are exchanged, so 1 is assigned to the third class instead of the second.
rationales.misconception: Reverse the two nonzero remainder labels after computing their lists.

rationales.derivation: Generating multiples as 3k from k=0 yields 0,3,6,9,12,15,18; the other two lists remain correct. Zero is not a member of the given set.
rationales.misconception: Generate multiples from zero without intersecting with the specified 1..20 domain.

rationales.derivation: Each integer is 3q+r with unique r in {0,1,2}; these lists contain all twenty values once with the prescribed class labels.
Writing periodic groups starting at 1,2,3 and naming them classes one,two,three produces the displayed cyclic assignment. Its first class contains 1, which is not a multiple of 3.
rationales.misconception: Number the periodic starting residues 1,2,3 instead of matching the stated residue order 0,1,2.

view.stem: 下面哪些分类能把图中的全部图形分组，使每个图形恰好属于一类？

options.text: 三角形、四边形、带阴影图形三类。
带阴影图形、白色图形两类。

intent.task: Judge all four proposed classifications by both exhaustiveness and nonoverlap.
intent.source_solution: Two triangles, two quadrilaterals and two circles are visible. A omits both circles. B puts the shaded triangle and quadrilateral in two classes each. C covers all six by shape once; D covers four shaded and two unshaded figures once.
intent.unit_reason: Native multiple selection preserves the four competing classifications without combination codes or yes/no splitting.
limitations: Does not require writing a separate justification for each failed classification.

figure_observations.observation: Full image has six separated objects: unshaded quadrilateral and triangle above, a shaded upper-right circle, a shaded middle triangle, a shaded right quadrilateral and a shaded lower-left circle. Rightmost and bottommost boundaries are visible.

rationales.derivation: Assign both triangles to triangle and both quadrilaterals to quadrilateral; neither of the two circles belongs to either class.
rationales.misconception: Check only that the proposed classes do not overlap, ignoring uncovered objects.

rationales.derivation: The shaded triangle belongs to both triangle and shaded, and the shaded quadrilateral belongs to both quadrilateral and shaded; coverage alone is insufficient.
rationales.misconception: Add a covering shaded class without checking overlap with existing shape classes.

rationales.derivation: The three shape classes contain two objects each, have no shared object and cover all six.
Every visible figure is either shaded or unshaded and none is both; group sizes are four and two.

view.stem: 按图填写表格，再用一个单位高度表示一个图形，画三角形、四边形、圆的数量条形图。哪份完整结果正确？候选表的列依次为三角形、四边形、圆、共计。

intent.task: Fill every shading-by-shape table cell and determine all three shape-count bar heights.
intent.source_solution: Rows shaded,unshaded,total are (1,1,2,4),(1,1,0,2),(2,2,2,6); bars are (2,2,2) at the explicitly stated unit scale.
intent.unit_reason: One coherent whole table plus ordered bar-height tuple keeps both classifications and row/column totals.
limitations: Choosing a complete filled table does not demonstrate independently filling its cells.
A bar-height specification does not demonstrate drawing axes, labels and bars.

figure_observations.observation: Two shaded circles differ in size and position and both must be counted; the long shaded middle polygon has three vertices. All six objects and outer boundaries are visible.
Full blank table has four rows and five columns: Class,Triangle,Quad.,Circle,Total across; Shaded,Unshaded,Total down. Last Total column and bottom row are visible.

rationales.derivation: Misread the lower-left shaded circle as white, transferring one circle from shaded to unshaded. Rows become (1,1,1,3),(1,1,1,3); shape totals remain (2,2,2,6).
rationales.misconception: Classify a shaded circle by an imagined white interior while preserving the shape count.

rationales.derivation: Treat the two circles as one repeated shape, count one shaded circle, then sum rows and columns to obtain total five and bars (2,2,1).
rationales.misconception: Deduplicate two separate drawn objects just because both are circles.

rationales.derivation: Assign the long shaded triangle to quadrilaterals, moving its one count from shaded triangle to shaded quadrilateral. The resulting shape totals are 1,3,2.
rationales.misconception: Judge an elongated three-vertex polygon by its silhouette instead of counting sides.

rationales.derivation: Count shaded triangle 1,quadrilateral 1,circle 2; unshaded triangle 1,quadrilateral 1,circle 0. Sum each row and column; each shape total is 2.

view.stem: 要作 $|AB|=5.6$ 厘米、$\angle A=40^\circ$、$\angle B=65^\circ$ 的三角形 $ABC$，再过 $C$ 作 $AB$ 的平行线。下列步骤中的两条角射线都取在 $AB$ 同一侧并朝三角形内部。哪套步骤满足全部要求？

options.text: 作 $AB=5.6$ 厘米；在 $A$ 作与 $AB$ 成 $40^\circ$ 的射线，在 $B$ 作与 $BA$ 成 $65^\circ$ 的射线，交于 $C$；过 $C$ 作与 $AB$ 垂直的直线。
作 $AB=5.6$ 厘米；在 $A$ 作与 $AB$ 成 $40^\circ$ 的射线，在 $B$ 作与 $BA$ 成 $65^\circ$ 的射线，交于 $C$；过 $C$ 作与 $AB$ 平行的直线。
作 $AB=5.6$ 厘米；在 $A$ 作与 $AB$ 成 $65^\circ$ 的射线，在 $B$ 作与 $BA$ 成 $40^\circ$ 的射线，交于 $C$；过 $C$ 作与 $AB$ 平行的直线。
作 $AB=5.6$ 厘米；在 $A$ 作与 $AB$ 成 $40^\circ$ 的射线，在 $B$ 作与 $BA$ 成 $65^\circ$ 的射线，交于 $C$；过 $C$ 作与 $AC$ 重合的直线。

intent.task: Specify the complete two-angle/base triangle construction and the parallel through its third vertex.
intent.source_solution: The inward 40-degree ray at A and 65-degree ray at B meet at C with C=75 degrees. Through C, slide a set square aligned to AB along a fixed ruler and draw the parallel. AC meets AB at angle40, so it cannot be that parallel.
intent.unit_reason: A complete construction programme retains both endpoint-angle assignments and the additional through-C parallel rather than asking only the triangle angle sum.
limitations: Recognition of a construction programme does not demonstrate compass/protractor/set-square handling or actual drawing accuracy.

rationales.derivation: Keep the base and angles but turn the set square through a right angle before drawing the final line. It meets AB at90 degrees, not a parallel direction.
rationales.misconception: Use the perpendicular drawing edge instead of the edge parallel to the base.

rationales.derivation: The rays enforce both given angles and form a nondegenerate triangle; the final through-C line has the direction of AB.
Attach65 to A and40 to B instead of the given assignments. Their sum is unchanged but the labelled endpoint conditions are both false.
rationales.misconception: Treat two specified endpoint angles as an unordered pair.

rationales.derivation: Use side AC as the required through-C line. AC intersects AB at A with angle40, so it is not parallel to AB.
rationales.misconception: Satisfy only through-C incidence and ignore the required direction.

view.stem: 把每个加数化成小数再相加：① $\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}$；② $\frac{1}{5}+\frac{1}{10}$。哪份两行计算完整且正确？

intent.task: Convert all four fractions and carry out the two requested decimal additions.
intent.unit_reason: One ordered pair of complete computations checks the shared fraction-to-decimal/addition procedure and both different denominator cases.
limitations: Does not elicit independently written long division or decimal-column work.

rationales.derivation: Encode 1/n as decimal .n: 1/2→.2,1/4→.4,1/5→.5,1/10→.10. Adding the mistaken decimals gives .6 in each row.
rationales.misconception: Write the denominator after a decimal point instead of dividing the numerator by it.

rationales.derivation: Convert the addends correctly but add original fraction numerators and denominators: (1+1)/(2+4)=1/3 and (1+1)/(5+10)=2/15, whose decimals are .333... and .1333....
rationales.misconception: Use componentwise fraction addition to obtain the sum despite correctly converted addends.

rationales.derivation: For different decimal lengths, add unscaled digits5+25=30 and retain two decimal places, giving .30. The equal-length second addition gives .3.
rationales.misconception: Right-align decimal digits rather than align the decimal points.

view.stem: 表中列出五年的发电量，单位为 $10$ 亿千瓦时。五年年平均发电量和每年的平均增长量依次是多少？

options.text: 年平均发电量 $1072$；平均每年增长 $58.5$。
年平均发电量 $857.6$；平均每年增长 $46.8$。
年平均发电量 $857.6$；平均每年增长 $58.5$。
年平均发电量 $828.25$；平均每年增长 $58.5$。

intent.task: Distinguish averaging five yearly levels from averaging four consecutive annual changes.
intent.source_solution: 741+800+857+915+975=4288;4288/5=857.6. Increases59,57,58,60 sum234;234/4=58.5. Both quantities use billion kWh, with growth per annual interval.
intent.unit_reason: A paired result keeps the different denominators and the relation between totals and changes; separate level-only and growth-only clicks would hide that comparison.
limitations: Does not require producing the sum, difference list or unit explanation independently.

figure_observations.observation: Full two-row, five-column table contains1970–1974 above741,800,857,915,975, in order. Last975 and all bottom border are visible and match the original scan.

rationales.derivation: Divide the five-level sum4288 by the number of changes4:4288/4=1072. Growth still uses234/4=58.5.
rationales.misconception: Use the four annual intervals as the divisor for the five annual observations.

rationales.derivation: The level mean4288/5=857.6 is correct; divide total change975-741=234 by the five labelled years to get46.8.
rationales.misconception: Count five year labels as five consecutive growth intervals.

rationales.derivation: Average five levels with divisor5 and four increments with divisor4; values are857.6 and58.5.
Omit the final level975 when averaging, obtaining(741+800+857+915)/4=3313/4=828.25. Keep the correct endpoint-change calculation234/4.
rationales.misconception: Confuse the last level with an endpoint used only for growth and exclude it from the level mean.

view.stem: 把英语字母集合 $\{a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j\}$ 分成元音字母和辅音字母两类。哪一组分类完整且正确？

intent.task: Classify exactly the supplied English letters, without overlapping classes, omissions or outside members.
intent.source_solution: The selected English set intersects vowel letters{a,e,i,o,u} in{a,e,i}; its complement within the supplied set is{b,c,d,f,g,h,j}.
intent.unit_reason: One complete partition makes coverage and disjointness substantive alongside membership; per-letter yes/no answers would not test that structure.
limitations: Does not demonstrate independently generating the two lists.
Uses the modern edition's explicitly English alphabet, not knowledge of the original Russian-letter list.

rationales.derivation: Put i in the vowel set correctly, then mistakenly leave it in the consonant list as well. The two classes intersect at i.
rationales.misconception: Build a second class without removing every already classified vowel.

rationales.derivation: List a,e as vowels and remove all a,e,i from the consonants; i consequently appears in neither class.
rationales.misconception: Recognize i as not consonant but omit it from the vowel list.

rationales.derivation: Copy all five English vowel letters{a,e,i,o,u} without restricting to the supplied a..j set. Outside members o,u enter the classification.
rationales.misconception: Classify the entire alphabet's vowel inventory instead of intersecting it with the given set.

rationales.derivation: Use{a,e,i} and all remaining seven supplied letters; their disjoint union is the original ten-letter set.

view.stem: 把图中对象分成植物和动物两类，再画数量条形图，每个对象对应一个单位高度。哪份分类和两根柱高同时正确？

options.text: 植物：针叶树、阔叶树；动物：向日葵、狼、兔、熊、山羊、象。植物柱高 $2$，动物柱高 $6$。
植物：针叶树、阔叶树、向日葵；动物：狼、兔、熊、山羊、象。植物柱高 $3$，动物柱高 $5$。
植物：针叶树、阔叶树、向日葵；动物：狼、兔、熊、山羊、象。植物柱高 $5$，动物柱高 $3$。
植物：针叶树、阔叶树、向日葵；动物：狼、熊、山羊、象。植物柱高 $3$，动物柱高 $4$。

intent.task: Classify all eight actual pictured objects and determine the two population-count bar heights.
intent.source_solution: Conifer,broadleaf tree,sunflower are the three plants. Wolf,rabbit,bear,goat,elephant are the five animals. At the stated unit scale the bar heights are3 and5.
intent.unit_reason: One complete membership-and-count result preserves classification, coverage and the graph quantities instead of a counts-only shortcut.
limitations: Does not demonstrate independently drawing axes, category labels or bars.
Recognizes supplied member lists rather than generating them.

figure_observations.observation: Full image shows three separate plants across the top and five animals below: wolf,rabbit,bear,goat,elephant. The complete far-right elephant and all feet/plant bases are visible.

rationales.derivation: Classify only trees as plants, moving sunflower to animals. The resulting lists contain two plants and six animals.
rationales.misconception: Restrict plants to trees and classify the remaining non-tree flower as animal.

rationales.derivation: All three plants and all five animals are separated exactly once; counts match the complete lists and the unit-scale heights.
Classify and count the three plants and five animals correctly, but reverse the category order when placing the counts on the bars. Plant height becomes5 and animal height3.
rationales.misconception: Swap the correspondence between the two category labels and their numerical bar heights.

rationales.derivation: Skip the small rabbit while scanning the bottom row. Four named animals remain and the rabbit belongs to neither class.
rationales.misconception: Count only large pictured animals and omit the smaller rabbit.

view.stem: 把被减数和减数都化成小数再相减：① $\frac{3}{4}-\frac{1}{8}$；② $\frac{13}{25}-\frac{2}{5}$。哪份两行计算完整且正确？

intent.task: Convert all four fractions and perform both decimal differences with correct place values.
intent.unit_reason: The full ordered pair of computations tests the common conversion/subtraction rule across two denominator patterns rather than isolated digit clicks.
limitations: Does not demonstrate independently written conversion, borrowing or column alignment.

rationales.derivation: Use .750-.125=.625 and .52-.40=.12 after equivalent denominator conversions.
Concatenate numerator and denominator after a decimal point:3/4→.34,1/8→.18,13/25→.1325,2/5→.25. Subtracting gives.16 and-.1175.
rationales.misconception: Read the two fraction components as decimal digits instead of a quotient.

rationales.derivation: Convert operands correctly but compute(3-1)/(4-8)=2/(-4)=-.5 and(13-2)/(25-5)=11/20=.55 for the results.
rationales.misconception: Subtract numerators and denominators componentwise despite correct decimal operand conversion.

rationales.derivation: Right-align digits75 and125, divide their difference-50 by1000 to get-.05; right-align52 and4, divide48 by100 to get.48.
rationales.misconception: Align the last digits rather than decimal points, assigning both operands the longer precision.
